basis_words: ACCOUNT AND HOUSEHOLD COLUMNS: the account dimension table (dry run) carries account_id (the account key, Orion accountId as a string) and household_id (the household key, Orion clientId as a string). The dimension holds 980 accounts, every one with a household; the cache holds the same 980 accounts. CONTROL: the all basis reproduces round 109's qtd rows household by household: the same not-comparable households, and every comparable gap within 0.01 bp of round 109's gap. The control was matched on the first run, so no method change was made. METHOD: the performance axis is the NYSE trading days from the base day 2026-09-30 to the cache's newest day 2026-10-14 (the calendar from the one frontier). Cache rows are used on those axis days only, so weekend partition days carry no value, and a household day is absent when no account of the household has a row that day. The window return is computed over the base day and the window days only; this equals the full-axis result for the window because daily returns chain consecutive trading days. Flows: the newest fact_transactions partition, status Complete only, classified by the round-109 module, with no unresolved type; a household's flow on a day is the sum over its accounts, and flows dated after the base day through the as-of day enter the window by the skipped-day rule. Orion figure: the newest fact_performance partition, factor on the as-of day over factor on the base day, minus one; five households have no row in that partition. WHAT EACH BASIS SUMS: all sums every row's currentValue (round 109); active_only sums only rows with isActive true; ex_cash sums every row less the cash lines. The flows, axis, window and figure are identical across the three bases. RESULT WORDS: no account-day in the window has an inactive non-zero value, so active_only equals all on every comparable household; the isActive question does not move the qtd figure. ex_cash moves the gap on a large share of comparable households in both directions and makes two further households not comparable, because their base value is zero once cash is removed. ALIEN PARTITION: the 2026-09-29 partition is inside the axis as a base for the 2026-09-30 return but is outside the window, which opens 2026-10-01; it does not enter the qtd figure. SURPRISES: the script writes the private variant file with the pyarrow table writer, a local write the order's step 3 requires; the first token scan of the checker named that writer; the issuer amended the scan at 33739dca3d, see the investigation row. Partition dates 2026-07-01 and 2026-09-28 are outside the qtd window and do not enter it.
